# source: setspace documentation (setspace.sty header) — the three spacing
# declarations, \setstretch, the spacing environment. Single spacing is the
# leading a document already has, so \singlespacing moves no ink where it
# stands (inert:default); the other two declarations carry the evidence.
pre impl \setstretch{1.2}
pre impl \onehalfspacing
pre impl \doublespacing
pre inert:default \singlespacing
body refuse:W0302 \begin{spacing}{1.5}x\end{spacing}
pre refuse:W0301 \SetSinglespace{1.1}
